key.name: columns
key.summary: Number of columns of the panel

key.name: layout
key.summary: Blocks of the panel, in order
key.description: Each entry is block:place. Blocks: header, media, quick-settings, notifications, calendar. Places: left, right or hidden. With one column, left and right both mean shown. Hidden notifications and calendar stay in the clock menu.

key.name: show-notifications-title
key.summary: Show the "Notifications" title above the notification list

key.name: calendar-show-events
key.summary: Show the events below the calendar in the unified panel

key.name: calendar-show-world-clocks
key.summary: Show the world clocks below the calendar in the unified panel

key.name: calendar-show-weather
key.summary: Show the weather below the calendar in the unified panel

key.name: header-date-format
key.summary: Date format of the header (GLib strftime syntax). Empty means automatic.

key.name: hide-messages-indicator
key.summary: Hide the unread notifications dot next to the top bar clock

key.name: custom-clock
key.summary: Use a custom format for the top bar clock

key.name: clock-format
key.summary: Format of the top bar clock (GLib strftime syntax, \n for a new line)

key.name: clock-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the top bar clock in points (0 = theme default)
